scope: E5: one static direct call, two exact linked layouts, macOS ordinary arm64

claims.claim: functional result, finite return, restoration and frame
claims.target: ve_call_contract for layouts a and b; caller 24 bytes, embedded M1 copy 76 bytes
claims.logical_conditions: existing copy conditions; aligned SP, 16 <= val SP; whole code bundle separated from destination and private stack; private 16-byte stack separated from source and destination
claims.providers: caller supplies initial registers, copy geometry and a valid private stack; the BL instruction supplies the child return address; the parent proof derives the child's code/destination separation; M1 child theorem supplies copy behavior; actual STR/LDR and SUB/ADD prove preservation and restoration
claims.external_trust: physical validity/lifetime/exclusivity of ordinary RAM and the private stack; ISA/CPU correspondence; HOL kernel and its execution environment; exact bytes mapped by the OS loader with the quantified common slide
claims.change: the child return address and its preservation are derived from code instead of supplied independently; a private stack contract is newly required

claims.claim: all intermediate data accesses remain inside source/destination and private stack
claims.target: ve_call_access_contract; stack slot reads/writes are 8 bytes inside a 16-byte frame
claims.logical_conditions: same geometry as functional contract; an arbitrary initial event suffix
claims.providers: parent ARM steps for the stack and BL/RET; M1 strong access theorem for the copy; proved widening of readable/writable ranges
claims.external_trust: model events describe architectural data accesses, not every cache/speculative/power observation
claims.change: the copy remains a stack-free leaf; the caller alone adds stack accesses and call/return events

claims.claim: the proof targets the actual post-link code and direct callee
claims.target: one external ARM64_RELOC_BRANCH26, zero addend; positive displacements 16 and -340 bytes
claims.logical_conditions: exact immutable bundle words; a common arbitrary runtime load base; aligned loaded code
claims.providers: restricted object relocation validation; actual linked BL decoding and target equality; exact complete callee bytes; Mach-O and LLVM symbol-position comparison; raw executable-span ingestion followed by expected-word assertion and kernel-checked code execution
claims.external_trust: Mach-O/LLVM readers and linked-span ingestion are unverified; linker and OS loader are not verified; file offsets and actual mapped bytes must correspond
claims.change: untrusted linker output is checked per result; no general relocation or linker-correctness theorem is claimed

claims.claim: bad stack, saved register and return target have concrete violations
claims.target: three separately linked caller mutations, unchanged M1 callee
claims.logical_conditions: explicit loaded initial states satisfy normal caller geometry; extra numerical facts are proved closed
claims.providers: initial-state witnesses plus finite ARM executions; isolated native runs with an unmodified normal control
claims.external_trust: native observations rely on host CPU/OS/test harness; a finite violation is not identified with a general Hoare-theorem negation
claims.change: artifact refusals, model counterexamples and native observations remain distinct forms of evidence
